title: Spotting the NSA by where number theory PhDs cluster around Fort Meade
place_text: Fort Meade, Maryland; Los Alamos, New Mexico

tellings.quote: you'd look at number theory PhDs and you'd ask what zip codes do number theory PhDs live in when they don't get an academic job that's visible and you find that they're clustered around Fort me.

plain: You could find the National Security Agency, the secret US agency that makes and breaks codes, by checking where people with doctorates in number theory (the maths of whole numbers, which codes rely on) live when they don't take a visible university job: they cluster around Fort Meade, Maryland. The mathematician Eric Weinstein offers this to Michels as his own reasoning, without naming a source. The point is that secret work leaves traces in where its experts quietly settle.
